title: providers.json
description: What a repository declares about who governs it: .agenticframework/providers.json (contract/gate/v2/protocol.md). A port this version does not read is ignored, so declaring one early costs nothing.

contract.description: The contract version this repository speaks, for every port that does not state its own. A provider's own version moves independently.

gate.description: Who answers the gate's events, or "none": this repository declares itself ungoverned, and the hooks and CI do nothing rather than fall back to whatever is installed.

command.description: The command to run, as a shell word list: `agentsmith gate`, `mygov gate --quiet`. It is run with the event appended and the payload on stdin.

version.description: The provider versions this repository expects, as a range. Recorded for a person and for tooling; the launcher does not enforce it.

contract.description: The gate contract this provider speaks, overriding the top-level `contract`. At 2 the `ci` event goes to the provider and never falls back to a framework path.

setup.description: The provider's own CI setup step, pinned: a GitHub Actions reference such as `bobbyaqlaar/AgentSmith/.github/actions/setup-agentsmith@v2.1.0`. Read by whatever writes the workflow; never executed from here.
